attributes.name: Robert Francis Leduc
attributes.summary: Leduc retired as president of Pratt & Whitney, a position he held since 2016. Previously, he held a number of senior positions for more than 38 years at United Technologies Corporation, including president of Sikorsky Aircraft. He is a member of the board of the Connecticut Science Center, and he established the Robert and Jeanne Leduc Center for Civic Engagement at the University of Massachusetts Dartmouth.
